description: We supply curtain wall and rainscreen cladding for a 20-storey tower, with structural cladding-anchor design under Part 4. Our engineering team ran computational fluid dynamics to get the cladding wind pressures, which come out lower than the code's static method. We'd like to design the anchors to the CFD values.
